_comment: alpha-fca v1.0.0 — Example Config. Copy to config.json and customize.

automation._comment: KEEP FALSE. Enabling this allows background task automation (use with care).

inbox._comment: Inbox/getThreadList access. Always true for a working bot.

smooth._comment: When true, shows typing indicator before sending message. Set messageDelay (ms) for natural feel. Recommended: false for low automation.

_comments.enable: Set to true to activate E2EE Labyrinth bridge.
_comments.saveType: 'memory' = keys lost on restart (safe). 'path' = persist keys to disk (survives restart).
_comments.devicePath: Used only when saveType='path'. Relative to your bot's CWD.

imgKeys._comment: Optional image hosting API keys. Leave null to disable image hosting.

_listenOptions._comment: These go in the options param of login(), not in this file. Shown here for reference.
